name: QR Scanner VR
summary:
QR Scanner VR brings real-world QR code scanning into your Meta Quest 3 mixed reality experience. Using the headset passthrough cameras, you can scan any QR code simply by looking at it - no phone needed.

Key Features:
- Mixed Reality Scanning - See the real world through passthrough while scanning QR codes
- Instant Detection - Powered by Google ML Kit for fast and accurate barcode recognition
- Controller Interaction - Point and click with your right controller to copy results or open URLs
- Scan History
